questions.stem: Explain why Huffman coding is considered optimal for creating prefix codes.
markingGuide: Huffman coding minimizes the weighted path length of the code tree.
The algorithm assigns shorter codes to more frequent symbols.
It constructs the code tree in a bottom-up manner using a priority queue.
questions.explanation: Huffman coding is optimal because it minimizes the expected length of the encoded data by assigning shorter codes to more frequent symbols. This is achieved by constructing the code tree in a bottom-up manner, ensuring that the most frequent symbols are closer to the root.

questions.stem: Describe the process of merging nodes in Huffman coding and its significance.
markingGuide: Identify two nodes with the lowest frequencies.
Merge them into a new node with a combined frequency.
Repeat the process until a single root node remains.

questions.explanation: In Huffman coding, nodes with the lowest frequencies are merged to form a new node with a combined frequency. This process is repeated until a single root node remains, ensuring that more frequent symbols are assigned shorter codes, achieving optimality.
